system.description: Grenade launchers are accessories mounted on rifle-sized firearms, adding 1 Encumbrance to their bulk. These weapons launch specially-designed grenades to the listed range, targeting them as if they were thrown normally; such grenades cost and function the same as their regular equivalents but cannot be thrown by hand. When attacking, the user chooses whether to fire the grenade launcher or the weapon it's mounted to, but both cannot be fired in the same round. Stand-alone models for vehicle or drone mounting count as 2 Encumbrance but are otherwise identical. Damage and Trauma Die depend on the grenade type loaded. Requires an applicable Contact to buy, being generally illegal for open sale.
